summary: Introduces two ways to run playbooks more efficiently when testing or debugging: start-at-task and step mode.
questions: How can I avoid re-running the whole playbook while debugging?

answer_card.title: Executing playbooks for troubleshooting
answer_card.answer_md: When testing or debugging and re-running the same play many times, use one of two alternatives: `--start-at-task` to begin at a specific task, or `--step` to confirm each task interactively.
